title: Discover the 2015 Maiora Custom 88ft Yacht
description: Explore the exquisite 2015 Maiora Custom 88ft yacht, where Italian craftsmanship meets high-speed performance, perfect for luxurious cruising.
html:
The 2015 Maiora Custom 88ft yacht is a testament to Italian craftsmanship and engineering excellence. Delivered in late 2016, this vessel offers a unique opportunity for discerning yacht enthusiasts to own a meticulously maintained, high-speed yacht with a shallow draft, ideal for cruising the Bahamas. With accommodations for eight guests and three crew members, this yacht combines comfort with performance, making it a standout choice for those seeking an exceptional maritime experience.

This Maiora 88ft yacht stands out for its custom features and thoughtful design. It boasts walkaround side decks and a large enclosed skylounge, perfect for entertaining guests. The yacht features a custom 4.5ft extended swim platform that provides ample space for a tender, enhancing its versatility. With only 1,186 engine hours, this low-hour vessel is a rare find in the market, offering both reliability and style.

Engine Specifications and Performance Details

Powered by twin Caterpillar C32 ACERT engines, each delivering 1900hp, the Maiora 88ft yacht ensures robust performance and a smooth cruising experience. With a cruising speed of 24 knots and a maximum speed of 32 knots, this yacht is designed for those who appreciate speed and efficiency. The yacht’s shallow draft enhances its maneuverability, making it well-suited for exploring shallow waters and secluded coves.

Luxurious Interior and Guest Accommodations

The interior of the Maiora 88ft yacht is designed with comfort and functionality in mind. It features twin master staterooms, two additional guest cabins, and a crew cabin, each equipped with en-suite heads and enclosed showers. The salon offers a spacious area for relaxation, complete with a Bose surround sound system, a 50″ Samsung flat screen TV, and a marble bar countertop with a Miele wine cooler. The galley is equipped with high-end appliances, ensuring culinary convenience during voyages.

Advanced Navigation and Helm Features

The helm of the Maiora 88ft yacht is equipped with advanced navigation systems, including Raymarine GPS plotter, radar, autopilot, and VHF. The yacht controller, along with bow and stern thrusters, provides multiple docking options, making it ideal for owner-operators. Additional features such as FLIR thermal imaging, a ship systems monitor, and a fire suppression system ensure safety and ease of operation.

Exterior Design and Recreational Amenities

The exterior design of the Maiora 88ft yacht emphasizes both aesthetics and functionality. The aft upper deck features lounge cushions, sun pads, and sun lounge chairs, providing a perfect setting for relaxation. The yacht’s swim platform, with teak steps and an electric gangway, facilitates easy access to the water. The large bow tender locker with a davit allows for convenient storage of a tender or jetski, enhancing the yacht’s recreational capabilities.

Summary and Unique Selling Points of the Maiora 88ft

The 2015 Maiora Custom 88ft yacht offers a harmonious blend of performance, comfort, and style. Its unique features, such as the large enclosed skylounge, custom swim platform, and advanced navigation systems, make it a compelling choice for yacht enthusiasts. The yacht’s low engine hours and meticulous maintenance further enhance its appeal.
